definition.title: Plan the site's page tree and redirects
definition.description: Read your connected repository's routes and navigation, work out how many clicks each page sits from the home page, and weigh that against a year of Search Console clicks and the traffic snapshot's visits. Get a page tree, URL and navigation rules, and, when URLs must change, the exact redirects: the next technical fix asks about each one and adds the ones you agree to in one pull request. Weekly follow-ups after a change compare clicks with the saved baseline. Plans only; changes nothing itself.

prerequisites.reason: The audit's crawl supplies orphans, click depth on the live site, cannibalization and the sitemap.
Page decisions name the merges and retirements the tree has to absorb.
The snapshot's visits per landing page keep a page with visits but no search clicks from being moved without a redirect.
The Code map points at the routes, layouts and navigation components in the repository.

mode.title: Plan, or follow up after a change

new_paths.title: New routes, one old -> new path or new route per line

new_origin.title: New HTTPS origin, for a domain move only

applied_on.title: Date the change went live (YYYY-MM-DD), for a follow-up

key_pages.title: Key pages (optional)
key_pages.description: Leave empty to use home, pricing, signup and the most clicked feature pages.
